from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PartyInfo(BaseModel):
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the party")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Role in the case (e.g., Appellant, Respondent, Defendant)")

class RulingDetail(BaseModel):
    description: str | None = Field(description="Specific content of the ruling (e.g., sentence term, fine amount, repair obligation)")
    category: str | None = Field(description="Type of the detail (e.g., sentence, fine, cost, restitution)")

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    case_court: str | None = Field(description="Name of the court issuing the judgment")
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The case number identifier")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Category of the case (e.g., Civil, Criminal, Administrative)")
    dispute_cause: str | None = Field(description="Nature of the dispute or specific crime charged")
    parties: list[PartyInfo] = Field(description="List of all parties involved in the case")
    main_outcome: str | None = Field(description="Summary of the court's final decision (e.g., Dismiss appeal, Uphold original judgment)")
    specific_rulings: list[RulingDetail] = Field(description="Detailed sanctions, orders, or costs explicitly assigned")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
